mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry(inquiryId, memberId, inquiryType, title, content, status, createdAt) VALUES (inquiry_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{inquiryType}, #{title}, #{content}, '대기중', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM inquiry q JOIN MEMBERDETAIL m ON q.memberId = m.memberId WHERE q.memberId = #{memberId}

SELECT inquiryId, q.memberId, name, inquiryType, title, status, TO_CHAR(createdAt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM inquiry q JOIN MEMBERDETAIL m ON q.memberId = m.memberId WHERE q.memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY q.inquiryId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT q.inquiryId, q.memberId, m.name, q.inquiryType, q.title, q.content, q.status, TO_CHAR(q.createdAt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM inquiry q JOIN MEMBERDETAIL m ON q.memberId = m.memberId WHERE q.inquiryId = #{inquiryId}

SELECT q.inquiryId, q.title FROM inquiry q JOIN MEMBERDETAIL m ON q.memberId = m.memberId
q.memberId = #{memberId} AND (q.inquiryId > #{inquiryId})
ORDER BY q.inquiryId ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT q.inquiryId, q.title FROM inquiry q JOIN MEMBERDETAIL m ON q.memberId = m.memberId
q.memberId = #{memberId} AND (q.inquiryId < #{inquiryId})
ORDER BY q.inquiryId DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET inquiryType = #{inquiryType}, title = #{title}, content = #{content} WHERE inquiryId = #{inquiryId} AND memberId = #{memberId}
